title: surgical-load-sentinel-and-transparent-readonly-fallback
author: Sonia Patel
release_notes: Introduce a lightweight load sentinel that detects short-lived KV pressure spikes and routes affected requests to a transparent readonly fallback to preserve SLOs and reduce error amplification. Backwards compatible config flags and a conservative default ensure safe rollout.

description: Context: We observed a pattern of transient KV backpressure spikes causing cascading retries and SLO violations during short regional pressure events. This change introduces a surgical load sentinel that detects short-lived KV pressure and routes affected requests to a transparent readonly fallback when safe. Motivation: Preserve tail latency and reduce amplified error/latency cascades without wholesale throttling of tenants. Keep changes conservative to avoid behavioral surprises. Design summary: 1) Load sentinel in controlplane monitors kvPressure, inflightPerTenant and recent error-rate histograms and computes a lightweight score. 2) When score exceeds a configured short window threshold the sentinel marks traffic for an incremental readonly fallback using a routing hint. 3) The readonly fallback path in route-mux preserves identity headers and KV snapshot tokens and returns best-effort read-only responses; write requests receive a soft-deny with clear error code to clients. 4) Circuit cooldown and penalty decay prevent flapping. 5) Feature gated and rollouts via sentinel-config with conservative defaults. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for sentinel heuristics and cooldown - [x] Integration tests for fallback routing and trace propagation - [x] Metrics and alerting for sentinel trips - [x] Runbook drafted and linked - [x] Staged rollout config included Commits summary: a1f4b8c initial sentinel prototype and tests; b2d9e3f integrate readonly fallback path into route-mux and preserve trace headers; c3f7a11 add metrics, alerts and runbook entries; d4e2b20 CI checks and threshold tweaks. Files changed (high level): services/controlplane/src/sentinel/load_sentinel.rs added core detection logic, comments, and Prometheus hooks; route-mux fallback path updates add readonly routing and header passthrough; runbook and staging k8s overlay for gated rollout; CI and console flag. Small snippet: `if kv_pressure.window(3s) > threshold && inflight_per_tenant > tenant_cap {mark_readonly_hint(tx)}` Review thread: Ethan Park: "Nice focused approach. Two asks: expose the cooldown as a config and add an e2e that simulates KV spike to assert no double-counting across tenants." Sonia Patel (author): "Added cooldown config and unit tests that exercise decay; e2e simulated in staging overlay, see staging config. Addressed double-counting by scoping metrics to tenant-id." Maya Singh: "We should be explicit about error codes for writes when in readonly fallback; will this surface to SDKs?" Sonia Patel: "Writes return a 409 with `x-redwood-fallback=readonly`; SDKs will map to a Retryable=false error; console flag documents UX." Julien Moreau: "Metrics look good, consider a low-cardinality 'sentinel_reason' tag for easier rollups." Sonia Patel: "Added sentinel_reason tag with values 'kv_pressure'|'inflight'|'err_rate' and tests updated." CI notes: All pipeline stages passed after second run. Unit tests 142/142, integration smoke passed, lint warnings fixed in second commit. Performance bench: synthetic kv spike test in benchmark-lab shows 28% reduction in 99p tail latency for impacted tenants with <3% cost overhead. Merge notes: Squash-merged into main after approvals from Ethan and Maya. Deployed to staging with feature-flag off for production; gradual rollout plan in runbook. Post-merge actions: monitor sentinel.trip_rate, sentinel.duration_p95, and readonly-fallback.rate for 48h; be ready to revert via feature flag.
